label: A Milanese Chiromancy
summary: A palmistry text of the Milanese school, or printed in Milan.

value.text: no. 119, Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany

claims.statement: Entered as no. 119 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Medicine, Anatomy, Astrology and Miscellany. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the chiromancy of Milan".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Chyromantia (Milanese). The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
